name: audio
title: Audio
description: Output and input devices: switch the default, set the volume, mute.
author: pal

settings.label: Volume level in the bar
settings.description: The percentage changes only when you change it, so as a permanent fixture it is a number you stop reading. After a change it appears for three seconds as feedback and then collapses back to the glyph alone; the standing answer is the popover, where it sits against the device it applies to. Always keeps it on screen, Never leaves the glyph to speak.

options.title: For a moment after a change

store.tagline: Switch the output or input, set the volume, mute
features: Every output and input in two sections, the default of each direction tagged `default`, the volume on the right, `muted` where it is
`enter` makes the row the default for its direction; a headset shows once under Output and once under Input
`cmd+shift+v` sets the volume to the percent typed in the bar
`cmd+m` toggles mute and stays in the list
The transport (`bluetooth`, `usb`, `builtin`, `hdmi`) in the subtitle when the OS reports it
Live: the defaults and volumes are read again on every show

actions.title: Set as output / Set as input
actions.description: Makes the row the default for its direction; the HUD names it.

actions.title: Set volume
actions.description: The percent typed in the bar, 0 to 100, on a device with a volume control.

actions.title: Mute / Unmute
actions.description: Toggles mute and stays in the list.

audio.description: Every output and input, the defaults tagged, with their volume.

keys.title: Set as the default output or input
Set the volume to the percent typed in the bar

input.description: The default input: live, muted, or none

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: The default output's route, and its level for a moment after you change it (see Volume level in the bar). Click mutes, scroll adjusts by 5%. The popover leads with the device in use — a slider a click sets anywhere along it, the level and a mute switch — then the other outputs as rows a click makes default, and the input in one line under them.

keys.title: Use the focused device as the output
Mute or unmute the output in use
Set 0, 25, 50, 75 or 100%; a click anywhere on the slider sets that point
Open the Audio palette in pal
Move between the other outputs; a click on one focuses it

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.description: Visible only when the default input is muted or absent. Click restores it to 75%. The popover leads with the microphone in use — a slider, its level and a mute switch — then the other inputs as rows a click makes default, and the output in one line under them.

keys.title: Use the focused device as the input
Set 0, 25, 50, 75 or 100%; a click anywhere on the slider sets that point
Open the Audio palette in pal
Move between the other inputs; a click on one focuses it

rules.description: A live mic needs no attention: off the strip.
Muted: red, so a call finds it.
No input device: red (turn Hidden on to leave it quiet).
